characters.name: As a whole
characters.description: Tropes shared by all the girls. Action Girl: A group of fairies who fight evil using their unique magical powers. Adaptational Modesty: In the first four seasons, all the girls eventually got at least one outfit — be it a fairy form or their regular clothes — that showed off their navel. Oftentimes more then one. Seasons 5-7 and 8, which bothretooledthe show to appeal to younger audiences, removed them (for the most part). Aerith and Bob: Some of the girls' names (Stella, Flora, Aisha/Layla, Roxy) are typical and modern, while the other three (Bloom, Musa, Tecna) have names that are more unusual and unique. Alphabetical Theme Naming: Bloom and Roxy’s names don’t rhyme with their friends' names: Flora, Stella, Musa, Tecna, Layla/Aisha.

characters.name: Bloom
characters.description: The protagonist of the series. Bloom is the Fairy of the Dragon's Flame, from the planet of Domino, but was sent to Earth as a baby while her home was under attack, and was adopted by Mike and Vanessa. She begins the series as a new student attending the Alfea College for Fairies. After saving Stella from an ogre attack on Earth, Stella realized that Bloom had magical powers and took her to Alfea in the realm of Magix. For the first few seasons, Bloom is essentially the newbie fairy, learning to use her powers. Bloom also wishes to know where she's from. While she has nice adoptive parents on Earth, she soon discovers that she wasn't born there, and is the last remaining survivor of the planet Domino. It is that moment she makes it her mission to learn the truth behind her home and family and find her missing birth parents. 10-Minute Retirement: When she leaves Magix upon learning Sky switched his identity with Brandon and is engaged with Diaspro. She returns when the Trix follow her home and steal the Dragon Flame and Stella comes to help. Adaptation Dye-Job: The first 3D animation style darkened her hair and added lighter orange/blonde tips at the ends,just like a fire. All Girls Like Ponies: Unicorns, to be precise. Bloom was lured into a trap by an illusion of a unicorn. Her Fairy Animal is also a unicorn.

characters.name: Stella
characters.description: Stella is the Fairy of the Shining Sun, and the princess of Solaria, a place she speaks highly of. She is considered a delinquent at Alfea for her antics, which is why she's a year older than her class. Because she's so self-conscious about her physical appearance, Stella may come off as being vain, but still cares deeply about her friends. Her powers come from the sun, moon, and stars. Action Fashionista: She has a very large wardrobe selection, though it's not typically worn in battle. Attention Whore: She absolutely loves the limelight and craves praise. In season 5, she fakes an emergency call to get her boyfriend to rush for the sake of seeing her makeshift fashion show, and she doesn't understand when Brandon and her friends get ticked off with her for it. Beta Couple: With Brandon. They start dating early in season 1 when she's under the impression that he's Prince Sky. When his true identity is revealed, she's initially angry, but they make up and Stella doesn't mind him not being a prince. (She was more angry about being deceived.) From then on they hold a fairly steady relationship, even when other ladies like Amentia and Mitzi throw themselves at Brandon. Berserk Button: Expect a minor tantrum if you mess up her hair or clothes or interrupt her when she's getting dolled up.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: Flora is the Fairy of Nature. Her powers come from plants and nature in general. She hails from the planet Linphea. Flora is very kind, caring, gentle, sweet, peaceful, friendly, loving, and mature. She is able to keep her head on her shoulders in a crisis, and is not one to panic. She is known as the goody two-shoes of the group, a position she likes having. All-Loving Heroine: Fitting forthe most goody-goodyout of the Winx. Flora treats everyone with kindness and is even polite tojerkasseslikeRiven(before hisCharacter Development),DiasproandChimera. Alone Among the Couples: In season 1 she's the only one of the girls who doesn't get aLove Interest. Her boyfriend Helia is introduced in season 2. Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: Is extremely embarrassed at her parents' antics when introducing them to her friends in season 7. Ambiguously Brown: Flora can be mistaken for either a light skinned Black or a very tanned Caucasian, but the creator confirms she was based on Jennifer Lopez, so she is meant to be Latina. The English dub for the reboot's trailer gives her a more pronounced Spanish accent.

characters.name: Tecna
characters.description: Tecna is the Fairy of Technology, with powers that come from computers and technology in general. She comes from Zenith. Tecna is highly intelligent. Like any good nerd, Tecna thoroughly enjoys math and science. She spends a lot of time doing things on her computer. As intelligent as she is, though, she does not always understand non-technical things, like manual labor. Some of the simplest things, like brooms and buckets, are completely foreign to Tecna. Tecna is not very good at expressing emotions. She looks for logic behind everything and is not good at understanding emotional-based decisions. She also does not outwardly show a lot of concern for her friends, though deep down, she truly cares for them all and would do anything to help. Accent Adaptation: In the 4Kids dub, she gaineda British accent. Adapted Out: Has been excised from theLive-Action Adaptation. Badass Bookworm: She spends a lot of time researching her next assignment or how to complete the Winx's next goal, and she is plenty capable of handling herself on the field.

characters.name: Musa
characters.description: Musa is the Fairy of Music, and hails from Melody. She puts up a tough front in front of others, but deep down, she tends to be the most sensitive of the Winx girls, and gets emotional the most easily. Part of that may be due to her sad family life. Musa's mother died, and her father is often away doing tours, not having much time for his daughter, leaving Musa feeling lonely. All Girls Want Bad Boys: She has a crush on Riven despite his really bad attitude. When they get together he softens up a little bit. Alone Among the Couples: After season 6 and her break-up with Riven, she's the only one of the group without a boyfriend. By season 8, they're together again. Beautiful Singing Voice: Befitting the Fairy of Music. In one episode of season 2, two fairies got distracted from their arguing the moment Musa walked past them humming a tune, with one Pixie Pet in awe of her voice and asking for another song. Famous producer Jason Queen complimented her voice after her audition. Her voice gets especially highlighted in season 6, where it was weaponized in her Bloomix, it unlocked the Music Cafe and Rumpelstiltskin considered it worth stealing. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Riven. She's crushing on him early in season 1, but he doesn't reciprocate and instead dates Darcy. During season 2 they start to get closer, especially at the Red Fountain Concert and in the Wildlands. Riven eventually gains feelings for Musa, and they start dating at the end of season 2, andRiven is seriously injured by Lord Darkarspecificallybecause he wentTaking the Bulletfor her.They break up in season 4 when Riven thought Musa was getting too close to Jason Queen, his jealousy causing many arguments. Riven regrets breaking up and manages to win her back over. However, their relationship remained unstable, and they broke up in season 6 — and then got back togetheragainin season 8.

characters.name: Aisha/Layla
characters.description: Aisha (called Layla in most third-party dubs) is the Fairy of Waves, and the princess of Andros. She has the ability to rearrange a substance called Morphix (sometimes referred to as plasma) into all sorts of objects and weapons. In the original version, Aisha is extremely opinionated and open-minded. In her early appearances, she is rather distant towards romance and males. It's later discovered she was arranged to be married, which possibly contributes to her wariness of romance. She is quite athletic and is also a linguist. Her bold personality causes her take more independent actions, so she often doesn't ask for help. She has proven to be just as skilled as the Specialists when it comes to fighting. Accent Adaptation: In the Dubbing Brothers versions of the movies, she has a Cajun Louisiana accent. Alone Among the Couples: In season 2, she's the only one of the girls without aLove Interest. Her first boyfriend, Nabu, is introduced in season 3.Happens again in season 5 when she's mourning his death.

characters.name: Roxy
characters.description: Roxy is the last fairy on Earth and the focus of the fourth season. She has power over animals, able to sense when they are in danger and heal them. She occasionally joins the group after season four, but does not appear in every episode like the other fairies. In season 7, she has a heightened role as the group'sMission Control. Roxy's status as a member of the Winx is complicated. She wasoriginally intendedto be the Winx'sseventh member, but when Season 5 was retooled, Roxy wasDemoted to Extra. However, promotional materials still referred to her as one of the Winx, mostly due to having beenmade before the retool. WhileWinxcreator Ignito Straffi has officiallystatedthat Roxy is a member of the Winx, the show itself never refers to Roxy as a member, only an ally who helps them out from time to time. Adapted Out: Doesn't appear in thefirst seasonof theLive-Action Adaptation,Justifiedsince it's a retelling of the first three seasons. Alone Among the Couples: She's the only one of the girls without aLove Interestoutside the Season 4 comics Animal Eye Spy: InWorld of Winx, Roxy can link her vision with Artu's.

characters.name: Prince Sky
characters.description: Prince/King Sky is one of the Specialists of Red Fountain, school for warriors. For the first several episodes, Prince Sky poses as Brandon, in order to avoid attempts on his life by assassins sent by enemies of Eraklyon, during which time Bloom falls in love with him, and he falls in love with Bloom. Despite being royalty, Sky doesn't seem very happy about it until he met Bloom. Amnesiac Lover:In season 5, Sky takes a hit for Bloom from Icy, injuring him and causing him to fall from a great height. He's miraculously alive from the fall, but now he doesn't know who Bloom is or how to use a sword. Bloom tries to jog his memories, but her attempts are useless, which leave him annoyed and frustrated. More time later, he regains his memories when Flora gives him the Pendant of Eraklyon, a present for Bloom that he had lost in the first episodes of the season. Arranged Marriage: In Season 1, he was engaged to Diaspro, a noblewoman and princess of Eraklyon. Back Stab: How hehelped kill Mandragora in the first movie.

characters.name: Brandon
characters.description: Brandon is one of the Specialists of Red Fountain, school for warriors. For the first several episodes, Brandon poses as Prince Sky, under orders by the King and Queen of Eraklyon to protect Sky from possible attempts on his life by enemies of the kingdom. Stella fell in love with him, thinking he was a prince, and was very upset when she found out he was just the squire. Likely, while Stella was certainly upset that he was not a prince, she was more upset that she was lied to. She has forgiven him since, though, and the two now seem very much in love. Act of True Love: He declares his love for Stella even ifshe remains cursed as a monster forever in Season 3. This assurance of love helps her break the spell. Arranged Marriage: Early on Season 2, Brandon and Stella landed on the Underealm, ruled by Princess Amentia, who developed a crush on Brandon and forced him to marry her. Fortunately, she made up her mind in the last moment thanks to Amore's (Stella's bonded pixie) intervention. Badass Normal: He's one of the strongest Specialists in a fight.

characters.name: Riven
characters.description: Riven is one of the Specialists of Red Fountain, school for warriors. Riven does not get along easily with the other Specialists, preferring to do things his own way, and not appreciative of any help he may get. When dating Darcy, he's even more upset with everyone else than usual, and a real danger to the Winx girls and the other Specialists. Musa has a crush on him, but he's very awkward around her, obviously having no clue how he's supposed to treat a girl. Adaptational Heroism: 4Kids dub only, due toDub Personality Change. The Atoner: His arc in season 2 is making up for hisFace–Heel Turnin season 1.

characters.name: Timmy
characters.description: Timmy is one of the Specialists of Red Fountain, school for warriors. Timmy is the smartest of the Specialists, and the team's strategist. He also has a crush on Tecna. Beta Couple: With Tecna. They are pretty much the most stable couple in the show, though that may be because Tecna tends to beOut of Focusmost of the time. Crash-Into Hello: In the comic, this was how he first met Tecna. More of aSuggestive Collisionsince Timmy bumped face-first into Tecna's butt when he was trying to pick up a battery he dropped. Fantastic Firearms: HisSci-Fi-looking blaster fires guided,Hard Lightorbs. It's never explained what exactly powers it but given that most of the setting's technology isMagitek, chances are it's probably the round gem heaped on top of it since it's the same color as the blasts. Timmy's weapon also doesn't seem to need recharging. Gadgeteer Genius: He manages the Specialists' ship and other gadgets and works with Tecna to build various devices.

characters.name: Helia
characters.description: Helia is Saladin's grandson or nephew, depending on the version. He is an art student. He's also a pacifist, and does not believe in fighting. He likes Flora and has put aside his pacifist ways to save her. He's not willing to do so for anyone else, though. Arm Cannon: Upgrades to a wrist laser in Season 6, and he's a proficient shot. Beta Couple: With Flora. Early Installment Character-Design Difference: In Season 2, Helia has a more muscular build on par with the other specialists, whereas in later seasons he's far more slender. Expository Hairstyle Change: He trades his side ponytail for sidetails in Season 4.

characters.name: Nabu
characters.description: Nabu is a wizard from Andros, and Aisha's arranged fiancé. Although at first he refused to marry Aisha, he quickly fell in love with her after even talk to her. Ambiguously Brown: He can pass off as AsiannoteSouth Asian or West Asianor Black. His name Nabu is from West Asia and is specifically from a Mesopotamian/Iraqi deity. Back from the Dead:He appears in the second movie, which is supposedly set after the fourth season. Nabu also appeared twice during episode 26, but these probably were animation errors. Beta Couple: With Aisha.At least until he dies in season 4, after he proposes to her. Beware the Nice Ones: He got pissed off only once by Duman, of the Black Circle Wizards. Nabudisintegratedhim, and then proceeded to kick the asses of the remaining Black Circle Wizards and foil their plan.All in less than ten minutes.Doubles asDying Moment of Awesome, as the effort to do all of that so fast literally killed him.

characters.name: Manuel
characters.description: Beta Couple: With Roxy in the season 4 comics. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: After appearing in the 84th issue, he vanishes without given explanation. Nice Guy: He's a very caring and friendly person.

characters.name: Roy
characters.description: Roy is a Specialist from Andros and an assistant to Aisha's father. He is introduced in season 5. At first, he serves as a yacht driver for the Winx (until they learn how to drive it themselves), but afterwards he sticks around and helps the group while courting Aisha, who he has a crush on. By the end of season 5, she seems to reciprocate his feelings.Butit doesn't work out for him in the end, because next season she falls in love withNex. Ambiguously Brown: Roy could be interpretted to be AsiannoteSouth Asia or West Asianor Black. His name Roy originates from both India and France. Did Not Get the Girl:Nex ends up with Aisha. Flat Character: Does very little during his screen time. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Like the other blond Specialist Sky, he's a generally pleasant and noble guy, and that'sall there is to him.

characters.name: Nex
characters.description: Nex is a Paladin (similar to a Specialist) and friends with Sky's cousin Thoren. He's introduced in the third episode of season 6 as a rival to Roy for Aisha. Like her, he's competitive and loves sports. Halfway through the season, he and Aisha start to bond with each other.Nex ultimately wins theLove Triangle. Beta Couple:With Aisha, as of season seven. Blow You Away: His original weapon created wind gusts and tornadoes. Dual Wielding: In season eight, he wields a pair of short swords. Hair Color Dissonance: His hair is light navy blue, butWord of Godstates he has dark hair (possibly black).

characters.name: The Trix
characters.description: A group of three witches who formerly attended Cloud Tower school for witches. They are also sisters and descend from the Ancestral Witches, the most powerful and evil of all witches to have ever existed. The Trix were the main antagonist in Season 1 and, in general, the most recurring antagonists of the franchise. Adaptation Name Change: For the 4Kids dub, their official group name simply becomes "the witches", possibly to avoid confusion with aspecific cereal. Aerith and Bob: Darcy can be a real name, unlike her sisters Icy and Stormy. All There in the Manual: According to the comic series, they lived in a realm called "The Ice Kingdom" before the three of them left for Magix in order to become witches. Alpha Bitch: They're essentiallyRegina Georgewith magical powers. Which is probably why their theme song in the 4Kids dub is called "Mean Girls Rule". In the Italian dub, Darcy and Regina George even have the same voice actress,Federica De Bortoli.

characters.name: Lord Darkar/The Shadow Phoenix
characters.description: The main villain of season 2. Adaptational Sympathy: In the 4kids dub, Lord Darkar was a former wizard subject toDemonic Possessionby the Phoenix Fire, has several comedic lines, and is unrelated to the Ancestral Witches. In the original, nowhere is he stated to not possess agency and he's played dead seriously. Black Eyes of Evil: They even twinkle red when he's excited. Card-Carrying Villain: He doesn't have much motivation other than power and control. He also enjoys tormenting people, such as the pixies orthe real Avalon. Dark Is Evil: His name, powers, and appearance leave little to the imagination. Justified, he is the polar opposite of the the Great Dragon (that is a source of light, life and energy).

characters.name: Valtor
characters.description: The main villain from season 3. He has a strong connection with Bloom, since he has the same power as she, and fought against her parents in the past. A member of the Ancient Witch Coven. Returns in Season 8 Back from the Dead: In Season 8. Badass Longcoat: Part of his primaryVictorian-styled outfit, which he rarely takes off. Big Bad: Season's 3 and 8. Casting a Shadow: He used darkness magic he stole to neutralize Flora's nature powers.

characters.name: Mandragora
characters.description: The last surviving member of the Ancient Witch Coven, and one of the main antagonists of the first movie. Big Creepy-Crawlies: Commands an army of giant bugs. The Dragon: To the Three Ancestral Witches. Impaled with Extreme Prejudice:Courtesy of Sky. Marks the first time a villain being killed by an specialist (although Bloom struck the coup the grâce). Large Ham: SeeNO INDOOR VOICE.

characters.name: The Fairy Hunters/Wizards of the Black Circle
characters.description: The main villains for season 4. Long ago, they acquired the ability to resist fairy magic and this allowed them to steal all the magic from Earth. They are currently after Roxy who is the last fairy of Earth. They absorb magic and defeat fairies by plucking off their wings. There are four of them; called Ogron, Gantlos, Anagan and Duman. Big Bad: They are the main antagonists of Season 4. Promotional artwork indicates they're likely the villains once more in season 9. Casting a Shadow: They all have at least some shadow powers. Curb-Stomp Battle: In their first introduction, they defeat the Winx easily. Dark Is Evil: Wizards of theBlackCircle after all, and unlike the Trix they aren't given any humanizing moments.

characters.name: The Three Ancestral Witches
characters.description: According to some, these women were the very first witches who ever existed, and rumors were that they were the most powerful beings in the entire universe. They attacked Domino when Bloom was a baby, and reduced it to a frozen wasteland, but they were killed in the process. Abusive Parents: They treat their "son" Valtor awfully and brainwash him into being their tool to destroy the Magic Dimension. Big Bad:Winx Club: The Secret of the Lost KingdomandWinx Club 3D: Magical Adventure. Deader than Dead: Their ultimate fate inMagical Adventure. After the Winx perform a Believix convergence (which summons the purest essence of the Dragon Flame), the Ancestral Witches were extracted out of the Trix's bodies and they all dissipate into nothingness. Death by Origin Story: They were apparently killed during the attack on Domino, though they could still live on as spirits.

characters.name: Tritannus
characters.description: A mermaid prince who is the main villain of Season 5. After his twin brother Nereus is chosen by their father Neptune to become the next king of the seas, Tritannus made an attempt to assassinate Nereus during the coronation ceremony. Tritannus failed, and was sent to prison. After meeting with the Trix, the oil from an oil spill on Earth makes it into the prison. Absorbing it, Tritannus mutates into a monster and uses his new powers to break himself and the Trix out of prison. Tritannus is also Aisha's cousin. Back Handed Apology: After he is defeated and stripped of his powers, the monarchs of Andros condemn him before asking if Tritannus had anything to say in his defense or had any remorse for what he's done. He replies he's only sorry he didn't kill them all when he had the chance. Cain and Abel: He's the Cain, though he eventually settles for just turning his brother into one of his mermaid minions. Conquering Alien Prince: He wanted to rule the seas, but when his brother was chosen, he became bitter and tried to take the throne by violent means. Driven by Envy: He is jealous of his twin brother's popularity and lock on the throne. As such, he attempts to assassinate Nereus. When this fails, he retaliates by trying to conquer the whole Magic Dimension, brainwashing Nereus in the process.

characters.name: Politea
characters.description: Politea used to be one of the nine nymphs of Magix alongside her best friend Daphne, and thus, one of the most powerful fairies in the dimension. At some point prior to the Ancestral Witches' attack on Domino, Politea betrays her ideals and joins them. So, when Daphne requests her aid to fend off the villainesses, Politea refuses. This allows the witches to place a terrible curse on the Sirenix transformation itself, resulting in Daphne getting killed/becoming a bodiless spirit, and in Politea, who has now outlived her usefulness, turning into a monster of the abyss, forever haunting the Infinite Ocean. Sea Monster: The Curse of the Sirenix manifests differently for every fairy—the Winx risk losing their magical powers, and Daphne is rendered a disembodied wraith. Politea, on the other hand, mutates into an eternally hungry sea beast. In this form, she looks like a purple submarine dragon, slender and with fins in place of wings. Purple Is Powerful: Both of Politea's forms (aSea Monsterand a Corrupted Nymph) heavily feature purple in the color palette. In the former, is her outer scales; in the latter, it's her clothing. This matches her status as a fallen Nymph of Magix who, on top of that, earned the Sirenix transformation.

characters.name: Selina and Acheron
characters.description: Selina is a freshman witch student at Cloud Tower in Season 6, and the keeper of the Legendarium, an ancient book with the power to summon horrifying monsters. Once the Trix took over Cloud Tower, she works under their employ as their latest weapon against the Winx. '80s Hair: Her hair certainly has a lot of volume to it... Dark Magical Girl: Of the summoning type. Dragon with an Agenda: To the Trix. Unknown to them,she is actually in collusion with Acheron. Easily Forgiven: Subverted. Bloom forgives her but the others don't trust her until she releases all the magic the Trix have gathered.

characters.name: Kalshara and Brafilius
characters.description: Kalshara is the main antagonist in Season 7. She seeks the Fairy Animal containing the ultimate power and goes on a quest to capture them all to fuel her strength. Alpha Bitch: Was hinted to be oneduring her time as a former classmate with Faragonda at Alfea many years ago. Animorphism: She can shapeshift into various animals. Big Bad: Of season seven.Before being deposed by the Trix in the episodes leading to the season finale. Big Sister Bully: She constantly belittles Brafilius most of the time, even using the Wild Magic she acquired to forcefully turn her brother into his current form.This trait ends up being her undoing.

characters.name: Diaspro
characters.description: The fairy of gemstones, princess of the Eraklyan province of Isis and Sky's former betrothed. Adaptational Heroism: The comic series, which exists in its own continuity, portrays her as a much kinder person. Aristocrats Are Evil: Not quiteevil, but she does lord her status over others, plus there was the time she accepted Valtor's help. Played straight in Season 6 when sheoffers the Trix her help. Arranged Marriage: Diaspro was betrothed to Sky by their parents when they were children, and while she was all for it he decided to break it off. Character Rerailment: After several seasons ofFlanderizationturn her into an outright villain, season 8 brings Diaspro back to her original characterization as aSpoiled Bratwho nevertheless isn't devoid of some decency.

characters.name: Knut
characters.description: An ogre who used to work for the Trix, but he defected. He currently works at Alfea as a janitor. Abhorrent Admirer: In Season 3, after the princess ball when Stella is turned into a monster by Chimera, he develops a crush on her monster form. The Brute: He was the muscleman for the Trix. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Has not appeared since season 3. Even Evil Has Standards: Stopped working for the Trix when he realized how dangerous they were.

characters.name: Amentia
characters.description: Amentia is the princess of Downland, a capricious young lizard woman with quite the martial arts skill. Action Girl: Uses no magic, yet she's able to go head to head with Icy. And Now You Must Marry Me: At one point, she tried to force Brandon to marry her. Arranged Marriage: Almost, with Brandon. Amore solved the mess and hooked her up with herUnlucky Childhood Friend. Chekhov's Gunman: After theArranged Marriagesubplot is resolved early in the season, we don't see her again until later in the season, when Livy happens to enter her realm while trying to keep the Pixie Village's Codex piece away from Icy. A few episodes later, the Specialists must ask for her help in order to reach Darkar's fortress.

characters.name: Chimera
characters.description: Countess Cassandra's daughter. She longs to be the one and only princess of Solaria. Accent Adaptation: Inverted. She has a noticeable French accent in the original Italian. She hassomethingof a vaguely European accent in the Cinelume dub, but doesn't have a different accent than the other characters in the 4Kids and Nickelodeon dubs. Curb-Stomp Battle: She went down after justONEattack by Stella. Deal with the Devil: Valtor gives her and Cassandra new powers in exchange for power of the second sun of Solaria. Driven by Envy: She is very jealous of Stella, and always wants everything her way. When Stella is getting ready for her princess ball, Chimera tries to ruin Stella's fun. Chimera states that she hates Stella because she is a pretty, beautiful, spoiled and lucky princess.

characters.name: Countess Cassandra
characters.description: A Solarian noblewoman that was at one point engaged with King Radius (Stella's father). She's Chimera's mother. Aristocrats Are Evil: She is one of the most influential ones at the royal court. Perfectly willing to brainwash her future husband and kick Stella out of the family. Deal with the Devil: Valtor gives her and Chimera new powers in exchange for power over the second sun of Solaria. Disc-One Final Boss: For Season 3, before the Winx take on Valtor. Gold Digger: Cassandra wishes to marry King Radius in order to take control of Solaria.

characters.name: Faragonda
characters.description: Miss Faragonda is the headmistress for Alfea, school for fairies, and once a fairy godmother. Big Good: Out of all the characters in the series, she has served as a guide and strategist for the Winx and is appeared in every season and movies. Cool Old Lady: She is well respected among her students at Alfea. Eccentric Mentor: Keeps plenty of secrets to let the Winx find out things on their own and doesn't hesitate to let them go into danger is she thinks they will come out of it stronger. Expy: Her personality and role of helping Bloom on her quests are similar to that of Albus Dumbledore from theHarry Potterseries.

characters.name: Griselda
characters.description: Griselda is the assistant headmistress of Alfea. She is also the Head of Discipline at Alfea. Barrier Warrior: As the teacher of self defense, Griselda is well-versed in defense magic. Defrosting Ice Queen: At the beginning of Season 1 she is more stern than usual with Stella and Bloom, but later becomes more kind to the Winx while at the same time remaining strict. Expy: Her characterization and personality make her this series' equivalent ofMinervaMcGonagall. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: She is very gruff and strict towards students, but is generally kind to all the fairies at the school as she is shown to care immensely for them.

characters.name: Palladium
characters.description: Professor Palladium is an elf who is a professor at Alfea. He teaches Potionology, technical charms and runs the simulator. Ambiguously Gay: His interaction withfakeAvalon in season two episode twenty is rather... interesting. No-Respect Guy: Mostly in Season 1 where he was not a very confident teacher and although very nice, the students did not respect him. Our Elves Are Different: He looks like the Elves depicted in theThe Lord of the Ringsbooks and the movie adaptations, both in his having pointed ears, his hairstyle and his facial appearance. They also possess the ability to evolve their forms as a sort of limited form of shapeshifting Progressively Prettier:In-Universe. In the second season he appears to be much more confident and muscular, having evolved his form since he's an elf.

characters.name: Wizgiz
characters.description: Professor Wizgiz is a somewhat eccentric leprechaun professor who teaches at Alfea. He teaches the art of changing from one form to another, which is also called Metamorphosimbiosis. Cool Teacher: He can be quite serious and also funny. Really Seven Hundred Years Old: He's over a thousand years old. You probably wouldn't know this just by looking at him. Recurring Character: He and Palladium are the only teacher that are appeared in every season so far. Voluntary Shapeshifting: Wizgiz, as the professor of Metamorphosymbiosis, is able to shape shift his body into form he requires.

characters.name: Avalon
characters.description: A Paladin who teaches at Alfea. His class of Magic-philosophy is a mix of magic and philosophy. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome:The realAvalon is seen briefly last time throughout season 3 without making any major appearances. Cool Teacher: He is an excellent teacher and is willing to help anyone who asks or when he sees that they are in need and is perspective. His students trust him a lot and often want to impress or please him Good Scars, Evil Scars:He has scars on his face that appeared when his facade was revealed. Hot Teacher: His students find him handsome, especially Bloom.

characters.name: Amaryl
characters.description: A fairy student who attends Alfea. Alpha Bitch: In the early season, she is hardly the nicest girl at the school, though, often whining and complaining. Living Prop: So far, Amaryl has appeared in every seasons except for Season 6. Sitcom Arch-Nemesis: To Stella in Season 2 (for unknown reasons). She even had tried to attack her in one of their classes, but was stopped by Professor Palladium and almost got expelled because of her actions. Ungrateful Bitch: She's scolded the Specialists when they saved her life from a troll, since they let the troll escape.

characters.name: Galatea
characters.description: Princess Galatea is the Princess of Musa's home world, Melody. Broken Angel: Briefly, when Icy froze and broke her wings to distract Musa from their getaway from Alfea's library. They'd set the library on fire, which forces Musa to save her friend instead of chasing down the Trix. Luckily, Musa gained her Enchantix form and healed her wings with the fairy dust. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Aster season 3, she made only a cameo apearance in Season 5. Magic Music: Galatea's powers are also related to music and sound waves like Musa, but specifically speaking, hers are melody. Nice Girl: She appears to be a friendly person.

characters.name: Krystal
characters.description: Princess Krystal is a fairy who attends Alfea and is also the Princess of Linphea, which is Flora's realm. Childhood Friends: With Helia. She assures a jealous Flora that are just friends. Healing Hands: Krystal has an immense knowledge for healing. However, it was unable to restore Sky's memories, because the Pendant of Eraklyon blocked her healing powers. Innocently Insensitive: She can be oblivious, as it took her awhile to figure out Helia's relationship with Flora and when she reintroduced Diaspro to Sky in hopes of reviving his memories. But, when she realizes the problems she has caused, she makes the effort to fix them and also tries to reassure the ones who have been hurt that there is nothing going on. Plucky Girl: Krystal appears to be a fun-loving, friendly and helpful girl.

characters.name: Griffin
characters.description: Miss Griffin is the headmistress of Cloudtower, school for witches. She believes in spreading the witchiness of witches to all her students, and believes witches to be superior to fairies. She's a former member of the Ancient Witch Coven. Anti-Villain: Although she started off as somewhat of an antagonist, indirectly encouraging the Trix in their power-struggle against the Winx, Griffin was eventually revealed to be a woman of sound moral principles, and aided the Winx numerous times in their fight against the forces of evil. Dark Is Not Evil: She certainly looks dark and evil, but she does have a noble heart. Demoted to Extra:The Secret of the Lost Kingdomand beyond, though she makes a return in season 6. Heel–Face Turn: In Season 3, it is revealed that as a young witch, she had once teamed up with Valtor to work for the Ancestral Witches. By her own admission, she wasn't willing to cross the line to mass genocide and planetary destruction.

characters.name: Mirta
characters.description: Mirta is—or was—a witch attending Cloudtower. She is not highly respected there, however, as she does not hold the core values of a witch that her peers do. Currently, however, she transfers to Alfea, where she fits in better. Mirta is a sweet witch who would rather have fairies and witches get along, whose personality is similar to Flora's, with a good head on her shoulders. At Cloudtower, Mirta was also very alone, not fitting in, however nice she may be to everyone else. Beware the Nice Ones: As sweet and nice as she is, she still started out as a witch-and can still cast highly-destructive spells using theAbsolute Power of the Ancestral Witchesif provoked enough. Butt-Monkey: She has often been ridiculed by the Trix at Cloud Tower because of her opinion that Witches and Fairies are not very different from each other and that they can be friends. The Conscience: She tries to be this for Lucy, with limited success. Cute Witch: At least until she becomes a fairy in season 2.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.description: Lucy is a witch attending Cloudtower. She isn't all that evil, but she's not exactly the nicest person around, either. Her desire to be popular is her biggest fault and blinds her. Adaptational Attractiveness: She's far more attractive in the Nick remake. Adaptational Villainy: In the comics, she's a loyal minion to the Trix. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Her last apparition is in season 3. Ineffectual Loner: She's always trying to prove herself exceptional, but whenever she does anything alone she completely fails.

characters.name: Saladin
characters.description: Headmaster Saladin is the headmaster of Red Fountain. Playful Cat Smile: He has one. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: His last appearance is in Season 5. Cool Old Guy: Despite his old age, Saladin was an accomplished and powerful wizard. Demoted to Extra: After the first two season, he appears only as cameo.

characters.name: Codatorta
characters.description: Codatorta is the head teacher at Red Fountain. It is presumed he is the Assistant Principal. Badass Normal: No powers to brag about, but he can handle anyone threatening the peace with his staff fighting skills in hand. Stern Teacher: He is a strict teacher but cares about his students. Two-Teacher School: So far is the only known teacher.

characters.name: Kiko
characters.description: Kiko is Bloom's pet rabbit. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: Kiko is a blue and white rabbit. Love Triangle: In season 4, he's the sign of affection for Aisha's Pixie pet, Milly the Rabbit, and Stella's Pixie pet, Ginger the poodle. More of a comical thing, though, as the two Pixie pets would fight each other for Kiko's attention. Non-Dubbed Grunts: Beginning with the specials, Dee Bradley Baker's vocal effects for Kiko are kept across all versions of the show. Plucky Comic Relief: His role in the show.

characters.name: Artu
characters.description: Artu is Roxy's pet dog. Canine Companion: He's usually by Roxy's side (even more often than Kiko is with Bloom). Heroic Dog: In episode 412, he lunges at Gantlos to help Roxy. Suddenly Voiced: Like Kiko, he temporarily becomes this as a result of Roxy's "Talking Animal" spell. Undying Loyalty: He protects Roxy at all costs.

characters.name: Fairy Pets
characters.description: Toy animals brought to life by Flora. They only appear in the fourth season. Suddenly Voiced: As a result of Roxy's "Talking Animal" spell. What Happened to the Mouse?: After season 4, they disappear without explanation.

characters.name: Lockette
characters.description: The Pixie of Portals and Directions and Bloom's bonded pixie. Cool Key: It helps her find the way to wherever she needs to go. Foil: To Bloom. While Bloom is brave and prefers to confront problems head-on, Lockette is easily scared and runs away more. In addition, Bloom is lost in her life looking for her past while Lockette knows where she's going with her powers. Magical Accessory: She has a hair clip that transforms into a scepter which helps her point people in the right direction. Prone to Tears: She's prone to crying when in trouble and freaks out a lot, especially if Darkar is involved. She manages to grow out of this eventually.

characters.name: Amore
characters.description: The Pixie of Love and Feelings and Stella's bonded pixie. All-Loving Heroine: Amore believes the world is a place where everyone loves each other. Foil: To Stella. They both are big on love, but Stella usually looks at beautiful things and superficial qualities in love while Amore likes the concept of love itself and pushes it on others. Long Hair Is Feminine: She has long hair and is the most calm and feminine member of the Pixie. Love Freak: She's obsessed over love and tries to push couples closer together.

characters.name: Chatta
characters.description: The Pixie of Chatter and Gossip and Flora's bonded pixie. Expy: She resembles Stella in appearance and in mannerisms. Foil: To Flora. Flora is quiet and doesn't like to interrupt people, while Chatta can't stop talking and gets in everyone's faces to make sure she's heard. Girlish Pigtails: Long blonde pigtails. Gossipy Hens: She's the Pixie of Gossip; Flora once pointed out that Chatta usually knows everyone's secrets.

characters.name: Tune
characters.description: The Pixie of Manners and Musa's bonded pixie. Curtains Match the Windows: Purple hair and eyes. Foil: To Musa. Musa is very outgoing and tomboyish while Tune believes in being lady-like and clean. They help rein in each other's excessive qualities. Graceful Ladies Like Purple: She insists on acting like a proper lady with good manners and maturity, which goes along with her purple color scheme. Proper Lady: She holds the image of a 'perfect lady' in the way she talks and acts proper just like a lady should.

characters.name: Digit
characters.description: The Pixie of Nanotechnology and Tecna's bonded pixie. Curtains Match the Windows: Blue hair and blue eyes. Incredible Shrinking Man: Despite her reservations about being called small, she can shrink down to the size of a flea. Gender Flip: Is a male inPop Pixie. Meaningful Name: The Pixie of Nanotechonology is named"Digit".

characters.name: Piff
characters.description: The Pixie of Sweet Dreams and Aisha's bonded pixie. Ambiguously Brown: She has tan skin and green eyes. The Baby of the Bunch: Piff is the only baby among the main pixies. Baby Talk: The way she speaks. Foil: To Aisha. Aisha is energetic and loves the outdoors, while Piff doesn't have a lot of energy and spends most of her time sleeping. Also Aisha gets a lot of bad dreams and Piff power is to give sweet dreams when sleeping on a sleeping person's head.

characters.name: Livy
characters.description: The Pixie of Messages. The Ditz: She's not very bright and frequently forgets the messages she's supposed to deliver. Thankfully, the paper she rides on always has her message. Flight: Her folded message surf board can sense if someone needs to send a message. Gender Flip: Is a male inPop Pixie. Nice Girl: Forgetful she may be, she makes up for it by having heart.

characters.name: Zing
characters.description: Appropriate Animal Attire: Zing wears a cream fluffy scarf around her neck. She wears a bee like coat with cream fluff on the end of the sleeves, yellow shorts and black boots. She wears a pair of yellow goggles with a pair of antennas connected to it. And she can control bugs. Friend to Bugs: Zing can call and control bugs. Gender Flip: Is a male inPop Pixie. Genki Girl: Zing is shown to be very hyper. Meaningful Name: "Zing" is often a synonym for ahyperperson.

characters.name: Caramel
characters.description: Tecna's new bonded pixie. Beware the Nice Ones: Caramel is always ready to rush into battle to help her friends. The Big Guy: She seems to be the hot-headed, "brawny" member of the group. Canon Immigrant: FromPop Pixie. Genki Girl: She is full-of-life.

characters.name: Cherie
characters.description: Musa's new bonded pixie. Canon Immigrant: FromPop Pixie. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Though very vain, she can also be generous with her friends, sharing everything she has with them. Weather Manipulation: Can change the weather according to her mood. Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?: The Bank Manager, Gnome Grind, who torments Cherie to convince her to open a savings account with him.

characters.name: Serena
characters.description: The keeper of Domino's ocean gate and Bloom's bonded Selkie. Meaningful Name: Her name comes from the term "siren". Odd Name Out: The only known Selkie with a traditional name.

characters.name: Illiris
characters.description: The keeper of Solaria's ocean gate and Stella's bonded Selkie.

characters.name: Desiryee
characters.description: The keeper of Linphea's ocean gate and Flora's bonded Selkie. Punny Name: Her name is a portmanteau of "daisy" and the name "Desiree".

characters.name: Sonna
characters.description: The keeper of Melody's ocean gate and Musa's bonded Selkie.

characters.name: Lithia
characters.description: The keeper of Zenith's ocean gate and Tecna's bonded Selkie.

characters.name: Lemmy
characters.description: The keeper of Andros' ocean gate and Aisha's bonded Selkie.

characters.name: Elis
characters.description: A unicorn and Bloom's bonded Fairy Animal. Unicorn: Its species.

characters.name: Shiny
characters.description: A Shinygreed and Stella's bonded Fairy Animal.

characters.name: Amarok
characters.description: A Magiwolf and Flora's bonded Fairy Animal. All Animals Are Dogs: Once he and Flora are bonded, Amarok acts like a destructive big dog, often pouncing on Flora to lovingly lick her.

characters.name: Critty
characters.description: A Quillcat and Musa's bonded Fairy Animal. Hidden Depths: She's pretty good at origami for a cat, being able to rival Helia in skill level. Nice to One: Critty varies from being aloof to aggressive toeveryoneeven with little provocation, but she's notably softer and sweeter with Musa, the fairy she bonded with.

characters.name: Flitter
characters.description: A Techsquirrel and Tecna's bonded Fairy Animal.

characters.name: Squonk
characters.description: A Cry-Cry and Aisha's bonded Fairy Animal. Prone to Tears: Well, there's a reason Squonk's species is called a Cry-Cry.

characters.name: The Great Dragon
characters.description: Crystal Dragon Jesus/God: The Great Dragon is basically this for Magix Draconic Abomination: ACosmic Entitythat resembles an eastern dragon made of magical flames. Also seemingly aBenevolent Abomination. Dragons Are Divine:The Makerof Magix. God Is Good:The Makerof Magix and itsGreater-Scope Paragon. The Maker: See above.

characters.name: Buddy
characters.description: Allegorical Character: Is very clearly meant to represent Bloom's "inner dragon".Possiblyliterally. Maybe Magic, Maybe Mundane: Well, he's definitely magical, but there is some evidence that he is actually aTulpaemboding Bloom's dragon traits as aLiteral Split Personality: Namely the mere fact he can talk, being called"Buddy", appeared after Boom's conversation with Daphne, mentioning that he's "lost" his parents (though that could be him being aTrickster Mentorto Bloom since they never appear) and dissapearing from the narrative after the episode (almost like reintegrating with Bloom). TheRule of Symbolisminvolved doesn't hurt this interpretation.This is all but stated in the end. Mentor Archetype: For Bloom inThe Island of Dragonsepisode. Our Dragons Are Different: He's a young child, can talk and may or may not be Bloom'sLiteral Split Personalityas either aFamiliaror aTulpa. Ridiculously Cute Critter: Far cuter than any other inhabitant of the Isles.

characters.name: Mike and Vanessa
characters.description: Bloom's adoptive parents. They're very caring, very loving for their daughter Bloom and wish her the best. Mike is a firefighter and Vanessa owns a flower shop. Absurdly Youthful Mother: Vanessa might almost pass as Bloom's older sister given her youthful looks. Ambiguously Brown: Vanessa has a darker skin tone than her husband. Calling Parents by Their Name: A somewhat more callous example than most, as Bloom stops calling them Mum and Dad after she finds out that they actually aren't her birth parents. Happily Married: They're shown to be a perfectly happy couple.

characters.name: Mitzi
characters.description: Mitzi is Bloom's rival on the Earth. Aloof Big Sister: She shows no concern for the well-being of her younger sister Macy. Alpha Bitch: She lauds her money and scooter over Bloom and her bike. Attempted Homewrecker: In season 4, Mitzi falls in love with Brandon and repeatedly tries to seduce him despite the fact that he's in a committed relationship with Stella. Brought Down to Normal: Was turned into a fairy, but lost her powers.

characters.name: Klaus
characters.description: Roxy's father, and owner of the Frutti Music Bar. Accidental Misnaming: Does this with the Specialists when he hires them at the Fruitti Music Bar. He referred to Sky as Smile, Brandon as Brandy, Helia as Tobias, Riven as Rivet, and Nabu as Booboo. Hilariously, when Timmy gives him a fake name (Jimmy), Klaus calls him Timmy anyway. Dub Name Change: Is called Rick in the Atlas Oceanic dub. Interspecies Romance:With Morgana, the queen of Earth fairies.

characters.name: Macy
characters.description: Macy is Mitzi's little sister, introduced in the first episode of season five. Action Survivor: Held her own against the Trix. Annoying Younger Sibling:Mitzithinks of her as such. Damsel in Distress: The Trix grab her to get the Lilo, then they drop her when she throws it and the Winx have to save her. Green Thumb: She is the one who cared for a magical plant named Lilo.

characters.name: Morgana
characters.description: Morgana is the queen of fairies trapped in the White Circle.First takes revenge on humanity once released but turned good. She is Roxy's mother. Abdicate the Throne: At the end of Season 4, she retires and lets Nebula take her place. Face–Heel Turn: She was once a good queen, but grew bitter towards humanity during her imprisonment. The Fair Folk: When angered, Earth Fairies act likeThe Fair Folkof legends and she's their queen. Fallen Hero: Initially, she was tired of living as the Queen of the Fairies and went to live in the world of the humans, where she found that there exists people who can be special without even needing to use magic. But, after having lost her family and sealed in her own kingdom, when she is finally free became outraged with the fact that when Fairies roamed the Earth humans revered them, and after the Evil Wizards trapped them, they were all but forgotten and left in children's stories.

characters.name: Nebula
characters.description: Nebula is one of the fairies trapped in the White Circle, but freed by the Winx. She used to be the Major Fairy of Peace, then became the Major Fairy of War after she was captured by the Wizards of the Black Circle. Demonic Possession: She possessed Roxy through the white circle in the episode named after her and goes out to take down the fairy hunters herself with Roxy as her vessel. Disc-One Final Boss: For Season 4. The Dragon: To Morgana. Good Costume Switch: Slightly. When she returned in Season 6, her wings gained sparkles to show her change in demeanor.

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: Diana is a powerful fairy who resides in the Amazon Rain Forest and rules over it. She is the Major Fairy of Nature. Amazon Brigade: The Amazon Fairies, Warrior Fairy and followers of Diana. The BeastmasterShe can control animals. It was also seen that she can mutate them. The Empath: Just like the other Amazon Fairies and Flora, she is interconnected with nature. Whenever it is in pain, she is too. Green Thumb: She has power over plants and other forces of nature.

characters.name: Aurora
characters.description: Aurora is the Major Fairy of the North. An Ice Person: Aurora possesses the power of ice. She is shown to have the ability to turn herself into snow to teleport. She can also use her "Blizzard" to create powerful blizzards and to freeze anything in her path. She also has the power to freeze anything into ice, which she manifested to stop Nebula from destroying her tower and Gardenia. In the Hood: Subverted. Aurora is never seen with the hood down, but her face is always visible. Undying Loyalty: She is extremely loyal to Morgana, standing up to Nebula's over-commanding tone when Morgana would not.

characters.name: Sibylla
characters.description: Sibylla the Major Fairy of Justice. Above Good and Evil: She is bound to her role of Fairy of Justice to remain neutral since she does not have the right to take sides between Good and Evil and between friend and enemy, and neither does she have the right to tell anyone which way to follow, even when she knows that people are taking the wrong choice. Reasonable Authority Figure: As the Fairy of Justice, whoever is under her protection is under protection from others. Token Good Teammate: Out of all the Major Earth Fairies Sibylla is the kindest and most peaceful and the Winx Club came to her in respect and even bowed to her.

characters.name: Eldora
characters.description: Eldora is a Fairy Godmother who lives in Gardenia. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: She is a wise and powerful fairy, but odd, funny and clumsy at the same time. Expy: She has a several similarities with Faragonda, especially their physical appearance and hair. Green Thumb: She knows powerful magic spells, which are related to floral magic. Fairy Godmother: Of Selina. She is the only known Fairy Godmother to appear in the series.

characters.name: King Oritel and Queen Marion
characters.description: King and Queen of Domino, and Bloom's biological parents. Also the founders of the Company of the Light. Aerith and Bob: While the name "Marion" is a common-sounding name (a French form of the name "Marie"), the name "Oritel" is unique and unusual-sounding. Arranged Marriage: Played with. By tradition the heir to the throne of Domino marries a person chosen by the king, but it's implied that they fell in love and proposed first and their marriage was arranged by the previous king to keep up the appearance. Badass Normal:Oritel seems to have no powers, but there is a good reason if the Three Ancestral Witchesfear him in melee distance more than the full number of the Winx Club.InWinx Club 3D: Magical Adventure, Darcy and Stormy attacked him with lethal force, andthey were barely a match for him in spite of their advantage in mobility and striking distance and his sword having lost the enchantment. Note that Darcy and Stormy proceeded to kick the ass of the Specialists and thedepoweredWinx as soon as he left to chase Icy, and bow to his awesomeness. Oritel seems to have no powers, but there is a good reason if the Three Ancestral Witchesfear him in melee distance more than the full number of the Winx Club.

characters.name: Daphne
characters.description: Bloom's deceased older sister, who died trying to protect her from the Ancestral Witches. Back from the Dead:At the end of Season 5 Bloom had used her Sirenix wish to have Daphne fully restored to her physical body. Big "NEVER!": Even though she's being viciously tortured, Daphne shouts "NEVER!" to the Tritannus and Trix after they demand to know the secret of Dark Sirenix. Big Sister Instinct: She willingly sacrificed herself for her younger sister. Cool Big Sis: To Bloom.

characters.name: King Radius
characters.description: King of Solaria, and Stella's father. Fatal Flaw: Radius'pridecauses many problems, several of which almost cost him his life. It's implied that this was the source of his breakup with Queen Luna. Horrible Judge of Character: It never crosses his mind that his second wife Countess Cassandra is essentially awicked stepmother. Parents as People: He adores Stella, but he's far from a perfect father. Male Sun, Female Moon: He is the Sun to Luna's Moon.

characters.name: Queen Luna
characters.description: Amicable Exes: Luna wants to be this with Radius, but he snubs her at every turn. She becomes more of this with him later on though. Chekhov's Gunman: We only saw Queen Luna in a dream of Stella's way back in season 1, then she finally makes an appearance in season 5. Light 'em Up: Prominently displays her magic in Season 5 and control light and luminosity.Lunacy: Fairly obvious based on her appearance. Lunacy: Fairly obvious based on her appearance. Male Sun, Female Moon: The Moon to Radius' Sun.

characters.name: Ho-Boe
characters.description: Jerkass Realization: Ho-Boe tried to pressure Musa to drop music, her passion and power, completely. He soon realizes that he had been selfishly trying to force Musa to do so in order to spare himself the pain of sad memories of his deceased wife while Musa was keeping the memories of her dead mother alive through her music. Took a Level in Cynic: Ho-Boe was once passionate about music, but after Matlin's death, he couldn't bear to be near anything that had to do with music.

characters.name: Matlin
characters.description: Missing Mom: She passed away when Musa was a child. Strong Family Resemblance: She resembles her daughter in terms of the face, but has pale brown hair instead of Musa's blue. Posthumous Character: Died years before the series began, and Musa frequently honors her.

characters.name: King Teredor and Queen Niobe
characters.description: King and Queen of Andros, and Aisha's parents. All There in the Manual: Their names were first revealed on the official Winx Club website, but hadn't been brought up in the show until the episode preview for S5 E15 mentions Teredor by name. Niobe is mentioned by name for the first time in the season 5 finale.

characters.name: Nereus
characters.description: One of Aisha's cousins, and twin brother of Tritannus. Cain and Abel: Abel to Tritannus. Unlike his brother who is vengeful and cruel, Nereus is kind and caring. Horrible Judge of Character: He felt that Tritannus just needed to be spoken to rather than a physical confrontation, only to be proven wrong when Tritannus mutated him. Our Mermaids Are Different

characters.name: Tressa
characters.description: One of Aisha's cousins, and the sister of Tritannus and Nereus. Ascended Extra: She and her mother only appeared in two episodes of Season 3, with the latter just being a cameo, but are given bigger roles in Season 5. Cowardly Lion: At first, Tressa was shown to be rather fearful and she herself admitted it. But she is just as brave and determined when the people she cares for are in danger. Our Mermaids Are Different Took a Level in Badass: In Season 5, it seems that her bravery has improved and she is willing to defend her kingdom.

characters.name: Miele
characters.description: Flora's little sister, who idolizes her. Adaptation Name Change: In the 4Kids dub, her name is Rose. Aerith and Bob: The name "Miele" sounds rather unusual for a name. The 4Kids dub changes her name to "Rose", which can be a common girl's name. Affectionate Nickname: She is called a variety of endearing nicknames by her big sister. A few are "sweetie", "sweetie pie", and "little blossom". Ascended Extra: Seasons 6, 7, and 8 give her a more prominent role after she was absent from the rest of season 3 beyond her one episode.

characters.name: King Erendor and Queen Samara
characters.description: The King and Queen of Eraklyon, and Sky's parents. My Greatest Failure: In the second movieit's revealed that King Erendor betrayed Oritel for the sake of saving his own world, a decision that has haunted him his entire life since. Parental Marriage Veto: Neither of them were too fond of Bloom to begin with, but they accepted her after the Patchamen incident. In the second movie, Erendor forbids Sky from marrying her due to finding out she's the Princess of Domino andbecause he betrayed Oritel to the Ancestral Witches, he felt that he doesn't deserve to have their families joined. Parents Suck at Matchmaking: Let's just say that their original choice of a bride for their son leavessomethingto bedesired.

characters.name: Thoren
characters.description: Happily Married:With Daphne. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Although he holds a grudge against Sky, he is gentle, helpful and friendly, shown when Daphne was trying to find the Treants' weakness and he assures her that she will be able to find it and even found a book for her to take a look at.

characters.name: Sapphire
characters.description: Icy's biological sister. She was transformed into a fox cub by a shaman witch who took over Dyamond. Animorphism: The shaman witch transforms Sapphire into a fox cub. Eyes Never Lie: Her eyes, which she shares with Icy, are the only thing not changed in her fox cub form, which is how Icy is able to recognize her. Forced Transformation: Was turned into a white fox cub by the Shamen Witch when taking over Dyamond. Morality Pet: Figuratively and literally, to Icy.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: A trio ofWicked Witcheswho attend Alfea and are the arch-rivals of the Winx, using the ruins of Cloud Tower as their hideout. Ambition Is Evil: They want Vexius'sMagic Staffso they can access the Omega Dimension, helping Vexius in his schemes to earn said staff. Arch-Enemy: They are collectively this to the Winx Club. Card-Carrying Villain: They enjoy hurting others and never refute any assertions that they're evil. Dark Is Evil: As witches, they specialize in dark magic and curses. Darcy in particular uses darkness.

characters.name: Aisha
characters.description: The Fairy of Waves, and a princess from her homeworld of Andros. Adaptational Early Appearance: She appears in the very first episode of the series, unlike the original where she debuted in season 2. Ditching the Dub Names: In the original series, most countries used theDub Name ChangeLayla (some of them ditched it in theNickelodeonseasons, while others didn't). In this reboot, she is Aisha almost everywhere, with only the German dub still using Layla. Making a Splash: She produces and manipulate water. Tomboy and Girly Girl: TheTomboyto Stella’s Girly Girl.

characters.name: Icy
characters.description: The ambitious leader of the Trix, possessing freezing powers which starkly contrasts with Bloom's fiery magic. Alpha Bitch: She's essentiallyRegina Georgewith magical powers. An Ice Person: She has powers over ice and snow. Arch-Enemy: While the Trix is this to the Winx Club as a whole,Icy and Bloomhave averystrong enmity for one another. Casting Gag: Icy's English voice actress previously voiced two playable ice-themed characters from prolific gacha games:SkirkandMisha.

characters.name: Darcy
characters.description: A member of the Trix, she is a witch imbued with the power of darkness, shadows and illusions. Arch-Enemy: She is one to Stella due to their opposing elements. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Darcy is quite good at this. Brilliant, but Lazy: She's shown to actually have more powers than she usually uses... But normally sticks to illusions and telekinesis. Casting a Shadow: As her name implies, she has darkness-based powers.

characters.name: Stormy
characters.description: The youngest member of the Trix, a witch with a short temper and power over storms and weather. Anime Hair: Her hair is rather frizzy and shaped like a cloud. Blow You Away: Destructive tornadoes are some of her main attacks. Dark Action Girl: More likely to let her emotions get the better of her and lacks Icy's planning and Darcy's scheming. Hair-Trigger Temper: She is the most hot-tempered of the group and is prone to violent outbursts.

characters.name: Sky
characters.description: A Specialist who is also a prince from his homeworld of Eraklyon. Warrior Prince: He is a prince from his homeworld of Eraklyon, and his specialist training makes him very adept at fighting monsters and villains whenever he's involved. You Don't Look Like You: Sky looks completely different from his appearance in the original series despite the return to long hair, to the point that he's unrecognizable.

characters.name: Robin
characters.description: A female specialist who also attends Alfea as Faragonda's assistant. Action Girl: As a specialist, she gets her fair share of the action as the boys do. The Smurfette Principle: While there are other female specialists present throughout the series, she stands out for being the most recurring female specialist.

characters.name: Damien
characters.description: A warlock (aSpear Counterpartof witches) attending Alfea both as a student and a caretaker of the magical creatures being tended by the school. Brought Down to Normal:In "Brother and Sister", he ends up losing his magic after surrendering his half of the Dragon Flame to Bloom to defeat Vexius for good. Composite Character:He is aSpear Counterpartof Mirta as a redheaded goth whogets bullied by the Trixandjust wants to have friends. Personality-wise, he takes after the original Riven in being aJerkasswho one of the Winx crushes on. He also takes after Valtor in having a connection to Bloom via both possessing the Dragon Flame, along with Selina in being manipulated by an evil wizard. One could also argue he takes after Roxy's connection to animals and unknowingly having a connection to royalty. Connected All Along: Midway into Season 1, it’s revealed thathe possesses the Dragon Flame like Bloom does, along with being Bloom's twin brother who also survived the destruction of Domino. Half-Identical Twins:He has the same fiery red hair and blue eyes as Bloom.

characters.name: Vexius
characters.description: The main villain of season 1. Abusive Parents: To Damien, unfortunately. He berates Damien for being weak and soft-hearted and pulls his hair in episode 5. Damien even kneels to him. Arc Villain: He is the primary antagonist of Season 1. Badass Longcoat: Part of his attire is a wide, sweeping cloak. Black and Blue and Scary All Over: His clothing is mostly black and dark blue and he's the mastermind behind the Trix's constant attempts to steal the Dragon Flame from Bloom.

characters.name: The Ancestral Witches
characters.description: The Corrupter:Heavily implied to be this to the Trix, as they may have been the "shadowy remnants" shown in a flashback of "Trix in Trouble" that have been haunting them since childhood to steer them towards their supposed "destiny" of inheriting the forces of darkness. Greater-Scope Villain: Being responsible for the War of Light and Shadow, these witches are responsible for the ruination of Domino along with orphaning Bloom. They also influence the actions of Vexius and the Trix as they seek to take succeed the Ancestral Witches and conquer the Magical Dimension. Posthumous Character: They are apparently dead long before the start of the series. Wicked Witch: The only examples close to this trope in the whole series.
